scenario: 面试官必问'你怎么知道视觉搜索真的在起作用?'。常见翻车:离线 recall 提升 8% 就上线,结果 CTR 掉了。
scenario_en: Interviewers always ask 'how do you know visual search actually works?' A common failure: offline recall +8% then ship, but CTR drops.
q: 评估视觉搜索要分哪两个平面,为什么两个都要?
q_en: What two evaluation planes does visual search need, and why both?
why: 两个平面:离线检索质量(Precision@K/Recall@K/NDCG,拿标注集算)和在线业务影响(CTR/加购/购买提升,拿真实流量测)。只看离线会掉进'离线涨、线上跌'的陷阱——离线独立评分每个结果,用户却整体看一屏结果。
why_en: Two planes: offline retrieval quality (Precision@K/Recall@K/NDCG on labeled sets) and online business impact (CTR/add-to-cart/purchase lift on real traffic); offline-only risks the 'offline up, online down' trap because offline scores each result independently while users judge the whole result set.
diagram:
flowchart LR O["离线检索质量
Precision/Recall/NDCG"] --> D["上线"] D --> N["在线业务影响
CTR/加购/购买提升"] N -->|反馈/A-B| O
options: 只需离线检索指标一个平面,离线 Recall 涨了线上一定跟着涨
离线检索质量 + 在线业务影响两个平面,只看离线会掉进'离线涨线上跌'
只需在线 CTR 等业务指标一个平面,离线标注集分数没有参考价值
两个平面指的是训练集和验证集,两者都属于离线评估口径
options_en: Only the offline retrieval plane; if offline recall rises, online follows automatically.
Offline retrieval quality plus online business impact; offline-only risks the 'offline up, online down' trap.
Only the online plane such as CTR; offline scores on a labeled set carry no signal.
The two planes are the training and validation sets, both offline evaluation.
optionExplanations: 离线涨不保证线上涨:多样性塌陷就是离线 recall 涨、CTR 反跌的经典反例。
对;离线快而可控但独立评分,在线慢但抓真实体验,两平面互补缺一不可。
只看在线会失去可复现的快速迭代基线;离线指标是上线前的第一道筛。
训练/验证集都是离线的,这里说的第二个平面是真实流量的在线业务指标,不是数据划分。
optionExplanations_en: Offline gains don't guarantee online gains: the diversity collapse is the classic counterexample where offline recall rises but CTR falls.
Correct — offline is fast and controllable but scores independently, online is slow but captures real experience; the two planes complement each other.
Online-only loses a reproducible fast-iteration baseline; offline metrics are the first filter before shipping.
Training/validation are both offline; the second plane here is online business metrics on real traffic, not a data split.

termDefinitions.meaning: 展示的结果里被点击的比例,反映视觉吸引力/相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of displayed results that are clicked, reflecting visual appeal and relevance.

termDefinitions.term: 离线-在线差距 / offline-online gap
termDefinitions.meaning: 离线指标改善但线上业务指标不升甚至下降的现象,常因离线独立评分忽视整屏体验。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The offline-online gap is when offline metrics improve but online business metrics stall or drop, often because offline scoring ignores the holistic result set.

scenario: 返回的前 10 个结果里,有 7 个是真正相关的椅子,3 个不相关。
scenario_en: Of the top 10 returned results, 7 are truly relevant chairs and 3 are irrelevant.
q: Precision@K 度量什么,这里等于多少,有什么盲区?
q_en: What does Precision@K measure, what is it here, and what is its blind spot?
why: Precision@K = top-K 里相关项的比例,这里 7/10 = 0.7。它衡量'返回结果的相关密度',易解释;盲区是不看 top-K 内部的排序——相关项排第 1 还是第 10 它一视同仁。
why_en: Precision@K is the fraction of the top-K that are relevant, here 7/10 = 0.7; it measures relevance density and is easy to interpret, but its blind spot is ignoring rank order within the top-K.
options: Precision@10 = 7/50 = 0.14,度量的是覆盖了全部相关项的比例
Precision@10 = 0.7,度量 top-K 相关密度,盲区是不看内部排序
Precision@10 = 3/10 = 0.3,度量的是返回结果里不相关项的比例
Precision@10 = 1/3,度量第一个相关结果出现位置的倒数
options_en: Precision@10 = 7/50 = 0.14, measuring coverage of all relevant items.
Precision@10 = 0.7, measuring relevance density in the top-K, blind to rank order inside it.
Precision@10 = 3/10 = 0.3, measuring the fraction of irrelevant results returned.
Precision@10 = 1/3, measuring the reciprocal rank of the first relevant result.
optionExplanations: 7/50 是 Recall@K(看全部相关项覆盖率),不是 Precision;Precision 分母是 K 不是相关总数。
对;Precision 分母是 K(=10),分子是其中相关数(=7),它只关心相关密度、不管排序。
算的是不相关比例(1−precision),定义反了;Precision 看的是相关比例。
1/rank 是 MRR 的量,不是 Precision;这项张冠李戴。
optionExplanations_en: 7/50 is Recall@K (coverage of all relevant items), not Precision; Precision's denominator is K, not the total relevant count.
Correct — Precision's denominator is K (10), numerator is relevant among them (7); it cares only about relevance density, not order.
That computes the irrelevant fraction (1−precision), a reversed definition; Precision measures the relevant fraction.
1/rank is MRR's quantity, not Precision; this misattributes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回的前 K 个结果里相关项占的比例,分母固定为 K,衡量相关密度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision@K is the fraction of the top-K results that are relevant, with denominator K, measuring relevance density.

scenario: 整个目录里对这个查询共有 50 个真正相关的商品,返回的前 10 个里命中了 7 个。
scenario_en: The catalog has 50 truly relevant items for this query, and the top 10 returned contains 7 of them.
q: Recall@K 度量什么,这里等于多少,需要什么前提?
q_en: What does Recall@K measure, what is it here, and what does it require?
why: Recall@K = top-K 命中的相关项 / 全部相关项,这里 7/50 = 0.14。它衡量'相关项覆盖率',前提是你得知道相关项总数(需完整标注集)。张力:K 越大 recall 越高但 precision 越低。
why_en: Recall@K is relevant items in the top-K divided by all relevant items, here 7/50 = 0.14; it measures coverage but requires knowing the total relevant set, and there's a tension: larger K raises recall but lowers precision.
options: Recall@10 = 7/10 = 0.7,不需要知道相关项总数
Recall@10 = 0.14,度量相关项覆盖率,需要知道相关项总数(完整标注集)
Recall@10 = 50/10 = 5,度量每个结果对应几个相关项
Recall@10 = 0.14,但和 K 无关,增大 K 不会改变它
options_en: Recall@10 = 7/10 = 0.7, and it doesn't need the total relevant count.
Recall@10 = 0.14, measuring coverage of relevant items, requiring the total relevant set (a complete labeled set).
Recall@10 = 50/10 = 5, measuring how many relevant items per result.
Recall@10 = 0.14, but independent of K, so increasing K won't change it.
optionExplanations: 7/10 是 Precision(分母 K),Recall 分母是相关总数 50;这项把两个指标搞混了。
对;Recall 分母是全部相关项(50),必须有完整标注才能算,衡量的是漏了多少。
5 没有意义:Recall 是 0-1 的比例,不会大于 1;定义算错。
增大 K 会纳入更多相关项,recall 单调不减;说与 K 无关是错的。
optionExplanations_en: 7/10 is Precision (denominator K); Recall's denominator is the total relevant 50 — this conflates the two.
Correct — Recall's denominator is all relevant items (50), needs complete labels, and measures how much you missed.
5 is meaningless: Recall is a 0-1 fraction that can't exceed 1; the definition is miscomputed.
Larger K includes more relevant items so recall is monotonically non-decreasing; saying it's K-independent is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回的前 K 个里命中的相关项占全部相关项的比例,分母是相关总数,衡量覆盖率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall@K is the fraction of all relevant items captured in the top-K, with the total relevant count as denominator, measuring coverage.

scenario: 调大 K(返回更多结果),观察 Precision@K 和 Recall@K 怎么变。
scenario_en: Increase K (return more results) and watch how Precision@K and Recall@K move.
q: K 增大时 Precision@K 与 Recall@K 各朝哪个方向走,为什么?
q_en: As K grows, which way do Precision@K and Recall@K move, and why?
why: K 越大,越可能纳入更多相关项→Recall 单调不减;但也纳入更多不相关项稀释密度→Precision 通常下降。这就是 precision-recall 张力:多返回换覆盖率、牺牲相关密度,要按业务在 K 上取平衡点。
why_en: Larger K captures more relevant items so Recall is non-decreasing, but also admits more irrelevant items diluting density so Precision usually drops — the precision-recall tension, trading coverage for density, requiring a business-chosen K.
tradeoff: 大 K(recall 高、precision 低) vs 小 K(precision 高、recall 低)
options: 两者都随 K 增大而单调上升,增大 K 完全没有任何代价
Recall 不降、Precision 通常降,即相关密度与覆盖率的取舍
Recall 下降、Precision 上升,所以 K 取得越大结果反而越精准
两者都随 K 增大而下降,所以 K 越小越好
options_en: Both rise monotonically as K grows, so enlarging K costs nothing.
Recall is non-decreasing while Precision usually drops — the precision-recall tradeoff.
Recall drops and Precision rises, so a larger K actually returns more precise results.
Both drop as K grows, so the smaller the K the better.
optionExplanations: Precision 通常随 K 增大而降(纳入更多噪声),不会两者齐涨;这忽略了张力。
对;这正是要在 K 上找平衡点的原因——覆盖率和相关密度此消彼长。
反了:大 K 纳入更多不相关项,Precision 下降而非上升,Recall 升而非降。
Recall 不会随 K 下降(命中数只增不减),这项方向全错。
optionExplanations_en: Precision usually falls as K grows (admitting more noise), not both rising; this ignores the tension.
Correct — this is why you must find a balance point on K: coverage and density trade off.
Backwards: larger K admits more irrelevant items, so Precision drops not rises and Recall rises not falls.
Recall doesn't fall with K (hits only grow); the direction is entirely wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回越多(大 K)覆盖率(recall)越高但相关密度(precision)越低,需按业务取舍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The precision-recall tension: returning more (larger K) raises recall but lowers precision, requiring a business tradeoff.

scenario: 一批查询里,用户往往只点第一个结果;某个查询的第一个相关结果排在第 3 位。
scenario_en: Across queries, users often click only the first result; for one query the first relevant result sits at position 3.
q: MRR 度量什么,这个查询贡献多少,它忽略了什么?
q_en: What does MRR measure, what does this query contribute, and what does it ignore?
why: MRR = 各查询'第一个相关结果排名的倒数'的平均。这个查询第一个相关在第 3 位→贡献 1/3。它抓住'用户没耐心、只看最前面'的场景;盲区是完全忽略第一个命中之后的结果好坏。
why_en: MRR is the average of 1/rank of the first relevant result across queries; here first relevant at position 3 contributes 1/3, capturing user impatience (they look at the top), but blind to everything after the first hit.
options: MRR 度量 top-K 里的相关密度,这个查询贡献 0.7
MRR 度量第一个相关结果排名的倒数,这里贡献 1/3
MRR 度量全部相关项的覆盖率,这个查询贡献 3/50
MRR 度量按位置折扣的分级相关性,需要分级标签才能算
options_en: MRR measures relevance density in the top-K, contributing 0.7 for this query.
MRR measures the reciprocal rank of the first relevant result, contributing 1/3 here.
MRR measures coverage of all relevant items, contributing 3/50 for this query.
MRR measures position-discounted graded relevance and needs graded labels.
optionExplanations: 相关密度是 Precision;MRR 只看第一个相关项的位置,不算密度。
对;MRR 是 1/rank 的均值,专门刻画'用户只看第一个'的单意图查询场景。
覆盖率是 Recall;MRR 与相关总数无关,只关心首个命中排名。
分级相关+位置加权是 NDCG;MRR 用二元相关+只看首个命中,不需要分级标签。
optionExplanations_en: Relevance density is Precision; MRR only looks at the first relevant item's position, not density.
Correct — MRR is the mean of 1/rank, built for single-intent queries where users look only at the first result.
Coverage is Recall; MRR is independent of the total relevant count, caring only about the first hit's rank.
Graded relevance with position weighting is NDCG; MRR uses binary relevance and only the first hit, needing no graded labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各查询第一个相关结果排名倒数(1/rank)的平均,刻画用户只看最前面的场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank) averages 1/rank of the first relevant result per query, capturing users who look only at the top.

scenario: 视觉搜索的相关性有层级:精确同款 > 风格相似 > 同品类,想让指标同时反映'排得靠前'和'相关程度深'。
scenario_en: Visual-search relevance is graded: exact match > style-similar > same category; you want a metric reflecting both rank and relevance degree.
q: NDCG@K 相比其他指标强在哪,代价是什么?
q_en: What is NDCG@K's advantage over the others, and its cost?
why: NDCG@K 用分级相关性(精确同款权重最高)并按位置折扣加权,既奖励'更相关'又奖励'排更前',能处理位置偏置。代价是需要昂贵的分级标注(不是简单的相关/不相关二值)。
why_en: NDCG@K uses graded relevance (exact match weighted highest) with position-discounted weighting, rewarding both 'more relevant' and 'ranked higher' while handling position bias, at the cost of expensive graded labels rather than binary relevance.
options: 强在只用二值相关标签就能算,几乎没有额外标注成本
强在分级相关+位置加权,能纠位置偏置,代价是分级标注贵
强在只看第一个相关结果的位置,天然抓住用户没耐心
强在完全不需要人工标注,可以纯自动从日志算出来
options_en: Its strength is needing only binary relevance labels, at almost no extra labeling cost.
Its strength is graded relevance plus position weighting to correct position bias, at the cost of expensive graded labels.
Its strength is looking only at where the first relevant result lands, capturing impatience.
Its strength is needing no human labels at all, computable straight from logs.
optionExplanations: NDCG 恰恰需要分级(非二值)标签,成本更高不是更低;这项说反了。
对;分级+位置折扣让它成为生产里刻画细腻相关性的首选,代价是标注贵。
只看第一个是 MRR;NDCG 看整个 top-K 的分级质量。
NDCG 需要相关性标签(还得是分级的),不可能零标注。
optionExplanations_en: NDCG specifically needs graded (non-binary) labels, so cost is higher not lower; this is reversed.
Correct — graded plus position discounting makes it the production choice for nuanced relevance, at the cost of expensive labels.
Looking only at the first is MRR; NDCG evaluates the graded quality across the whole top-K.
NDCG needs relevance labels (graded ones), so zero labeling is impossible.

termDefinitions.fullName: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at K
termDefinitions.meaning: 按位置折扣加权的分级相关性指标:越相关、排越前得分越高,能处理位置偏置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG@K (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a position-discounted graded-relevance metric rewarding more-relevant, higher-ranked results and handling position bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户更可能点靠前的结果,指标需要对排名位置加权才公平。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position bias is users' tendency to click higher-ranked results, which a metric must weight by rank to be fair.

scenario: 要在 Precision@K、Recall@K、MRR、NDCG@K 四个离线检索指标间说清各自适用场景。
scenario_en: Clarify when to use each of four offline retrieval metrics: Precision@K, Recall@K, MRR, NDCG@K.
q: 这四个离线检索指标各自的强项和适用场景是什么?
q_en: What are the strengths and use cases of these four offline retrieval metrics?
why: Precision@K 看相关密度、易解释、忽略排序,用于快速自检;Recall@K 看覆盖率、需相关总数,用于检索完整性;MRR 看首个命中位置、抓没耐心,用于单意图查询;NDCG@K 分级+位置加权、需分级标签,用于生产细腻相关性。
why_en: Precision@K measures density and is easy but ignores order (quick sanity checks); Recall@K measures coverage but needs the total relevant set (retrieval completeness); MRR captures first-hit rank for single-intent queries; NDCG@K uses graded plus position weighting for nuanced production relevance.
tradeoff: 易解释(Precision) vs 覆盖(Recall) vs 首击(MRR) vs 分级精细(NDCG)
options: 四个指标完全等价,任选一个都能全面反映检索质量与排序
只有 NDCG 有用,其余三个都是它的简化版本可以不用算
Precision 看密度、Recall 看覆盖、MRR 看首击、NDCG 分级+位置
Precision 和 Recall 等价,MRR 和 NDCG 等价,实际只有两类指标
options_en: The four are fully equivalent; any one reflects retrieval quality and ranking.
Only NDCG is useful; the other three are simplified versions you can skip.
Precision reads density, Recall reads coverage, MRR reads the first hit, NDCG adds grades and position.
Precision equals Recall and MRR equals NDCG, so there are really only two metric types.
optionExplanations: 四者各有盲区(排序/覆盖/后续/标注成本),不等价,不能任选。
NDCG 强但贵(需分级标签),快速自检时 Precision 更省;各有其位。
对;每个指标对应一个特定问题,选指标就是选你最在意的那个维度。
四个指标定义各不相同,不能两两合并;这项事实错误。
optionExplanations_en: Each has a distinct blind spot (order/coverage/after-first/label cost), so they aren't equivalent or interchangeable.
NDCG is strong but expensive (graded labels); for quick checks Precision is cheaper — each has its place.
Correct — each metric answers a specific question, so choosing one means choosing the dimension you care about most.
The four have distinct definitions and can't be pairwise merged; this is factually wrong.

termDefinitions.term: golden evaluation set / 黄金评估集
termDefinitions.meaning: 人工标注的查询-结果对,离线算这些指标的基准,须随 embedding 模型版本一起版本化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A golden evaluation set is human-labeled query-result pairs, the basis for offline metrics, versioned alongside the embedding model.

scenario: 视觉搜索里绝大多数查询是单意图(用户上传一张图,只想找到那一件),且用户往往只点第一个结果。
scenario_en: In visual search most queries are single-intent (upload one photo, want that one item), and users often click only the first result.
q: 这种'只在乎第一个命中'的场景,首选哪个离线指标?
q_en: For this 'only the first hit matters' setting, which offline metric fits best?
why: MRR 最贴:它就是第一个相关结果排名的倒数均值,直接奖励'把对的东西排第一'。用户只看首位时,MRR 的信号比 Precision/Recall 更对齐真实行为。
why_en: MRR fits best: it's the mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result, directly rewarding putting the right item first, so when users look only at the top its signal aligns with real behavior better than Precision/Recall.
tradeoff: MRR(对齐单意图首击) vs Precision/Recall(看整组但不突出首位)
options: Recall@K,因为要尽量覆盖所有相关项
Precision@K,因为要看整组结果的相关密度
MRR,因为它奖励把第一个相关结果排到最前,贴合用户只看首位
NDCG@K,因为只有它能算单意图查询
options_en: Recall@K, to cover as many relevant items as possible.
Precision@K, to see relevance density across the whole set.
MRR, because it rewards ranking the first relevant result at the top, matching users who look only at the first.
NDCG@K, because only it can score single-intent queries.
whenOtherWins: 若查询是多意图/探索型(用户想浏览一屏多样选择),整组质量更重要,应改用 NDCG@K 或加多样性指标而非 MRR。
whenOtherWins_en: If queries are multi-intent/exploratory (users browse a diverse set), whole-set quality matters more and you'd use NDCG@K or diversity metrics instead of MRR.
optionExplanations: 覆盖率对'只点第一个'的场景不关键——用户根本看不到后面的相关项。
相关密度不突出首位:Precision 对第 1 和第 10 一视同仁,抓不住'只看第一个'。
对;MRR 用 1/rank 强烈奖励首位命中,正是单意图、只看首位场景的对齐指标。
NDCG 并非只能算单意图,它更擅长多分级、看整组;单意图首击场景 MRR 更直接。
optionExplanations_en: Coverage isn't key when users click only the first — they never see later relevant items.
Density doesn't emphasize the top: Precision treats rank 1 and 10 alike, missing 'only the first'.
Correct — MRR's 1/rank strongly rewards a first-position hit, the aligned metric for single-intent top-only behavior.
NDCG isn't limited to single-intent; it excels at graded whole-set scoring, while MRR is more direct for single-intent first-hit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户只想找一个明确目标(如这张图里的那件商品),只在乎第一个正确结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A single-intent query seeks one specific target (the item in this photo), caring only about the first correct result.

scenario: 生产上线要的是细腻相关性:精确同款、风格相似、同品类应有不同分值,还要处理'排在前面更重要'的位置偏置,团队愿意投入分级标注。
scenario_en: Production wants nuanced relevance: exact match, style-similar, same-category should score differently, plus handle position bias, and the team will invest in graded labels.
q: 生产环境要细腻相关性且愿投分级标注,选哪个指标?
q_en: For nuanced production relevance with graded labels available, which metric?
why: 选 NDCG@K:它用分级相关性区分同款/相似/同类,并按位置折扣处理偏置,是四个里唯一同时抓'相关程度'和'排序位置'的。前提是要有分级标注,而这题恰好愿意投入。
why_en: Pick NDCG@K: graded relevance distinguishes exact/style/category and position discounting handles bias — the only one of the four capturing both degree and rank — given graded labels, which this team will fund.
tradeoff: NDCG(细腻+位置加权但标注贵) vs Precision(便宜但粗糙、忽略排序)
options: Precision@K,便宜好算,细腻相关性不重要
MRR,只看第一个命中就够了
Recall@K,只要覆盖率高就是好
NDCG@K,分级相关+位置折扣,唯一同时抓相关程度和排序位置
options_en: Precision@K, cheap and easy, nuanced relevance doesn't matter.
MRR, looking only at the first hit is enough.
Recall@K, high coverage is all that matters.
NDCG@K, graded relevance plus position discounting, the only one capturing both degree and rank.
whenOtherWins: 若还没有分级标注、只想快速自检一版模型好坏,先用 Precision@K/Recall@K 顶上,等值得投入再上 NDCG。
whenOtherWins_en: If graded labels don't exist yet and you just want a quick model sanity check, use Precision@K/Recall@K first and adopt NDCG when the investment is justified.
optionExplanations: Precision 忽略排序、只有二值相关,给不出'同款>相似>同类'的细腻区分。
MRR 只看首个命中,丢掉了整组的分级质量,不满足'细腻相关性'诉求。
只看覆盖率会忽略排序和相关程度,和'细腻相关'目标不符。
对;有分级标注这个前提在,NDCG 的分级+位置加权正好命中细腻相关性的需求。
optionExplanations_en: Precision ignores order and uses binary relevance, giving no exact>style>category distinction.
MRR looks only at the first hit, dropping graded whole-set quality, failing the nuanced-relevance need.
Coverage-only ignores order and degree, misaligned with the nuanced-relevance goal.
Correct — with graded labels available, NDCG's graded plus position weighting hits the nuanced-relevance need exactly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 相关性不是二值而是多档(精确同款/风格相似/同品类),用于 NDCG 的增益权重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graded relevance rates relevance in tiers (exact/style/category) rather than binary, feeding NDCG's gain weights.

scenario: 用一个人工标注的黄金评估集比较 v1 和 v2 两版 embedding 模型的离线指标。
scenario_en: Use a human-labeled golden evaluation set to compare offline metrics of embedding models v1 and v2.
q: 黄金评估集为什么必须随 embedding 模型版本一起版本化?
q_en: Why must the golden evaluation set be versioned alongside the embedding model version?
why: 指标要可比,前提是标注和被评模型在同一语义空间/口径下。若评估集不随版本走,v2 用旧标注或旧口径算出来的分数和 v1 不可比,比较结论失真。版本化评估集保证跨版本比较有效。
why_en: For comparable metrics, labels and the evaluated model must share the same semantic space and criteria; if the evaluation set does not track versions, v2 scored against stale labels is not comparable to v1, so the conclusion distorts.
options: 为了省存储:旧评估集可以直接删掉,只保留最新一版标注
为保证跨版本可比:标注口径要和被评模型版本对齐
为了加快评估速度,版本化能让指标计算更好地并行
评估集不需要版本化,任何一版标注都能公平比较所有模型
options_en: To save storage: old evaluation sets can be deleted, keeping only the latest labels.
To keep cross-version comparison valid: label criteria must track the model version.
To speed evaluation up, since versioning parallelizes metric computation better.
The evaluation set needs no versioning; any label version compares all models fairly.
optionExplanations: 版本化不是为省存储——恰恰要保留旧版本才能复现历史比较。
对;比较有效性的前提是标注与模型版本对齐,版本化评估集是保证公平比较的锚。
版本化和并行计算无关;它解决的是可比性不是速度。
用不匹配版本的标注会让分数失真,'任何一版都行'正是导致错误结论的做法。
optionExplanations_en: Versioning is not for storage — you deliberately keep old versions to reproduce historical comparisons.
Correct — comparison validity requires label-model version alignment; the versioned golden set is the anchor for fair comparison.
Versioning is unrelated to parallel compute; it solves comparability, not speed.
Using mismatched-version labels distorts scores; 'any version works' is exactly what produces wrong conclusions.

termDefinitions.term: 评估集版本化 / evaluation-set versioning
termDefinitions.meaning: 把黄金标注集和 embedding 模型版本绑定管理,确保不同模型版本的离线分数可比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Evaluation-set versioning binds the golden label set to the embedding model version so offline scores across model versions stay comparable.

scenario: 上线后要用真实流量衡量视觉搜索的业务价值,有 CTR、加购率、购买提升三类在线指标。
scenario_en: In production, measure visual search's business value on real traffic with CTR, add-to-cart rate, and purchase lift.
q: 这三个在线指标各自反映漏斗上的哪一步?
q_en: Which funnel step does each of these online metrics reflect?
why: CTR = 展示中被点击的比例(视觉吸引/相关);加购率 = 点击中被加入购物车的比例(购买意图);购买提升 = 相对基线(文本搜索/无搜索)带来的增量收入(最终业务价值)。三者沿漏斗越走越接近钱。
why_en: CTR is clicks over impressions (appeal/relevance), add-to-cart rate is carts over clicks (purchase intent), and purchase lift is incremental revenue over a baseline (text search / no search) — moving down the funnel closer to revenue.
options: 三个指标测的是同一件事,只是在漏斗不同位置换了名字
CTR=点击/展示、加购率=加购/点击、购买提升=增量收入
CTR 测收入、加购率测检索延迟、购买提升测离线召回率
三者都是离线指标,拿标注集就能算,不需要真实线上流量
options_en: The three measure the same thing, just renamed at different funnel positions.
CTR = clicks/impressions, add-to-cart = carts/clicks, purchase lift = incremental revenue.
CTR measures revenue, add-to-cart measures retrieval latency, purchase lift measures offline recall.
All three are offline metrics computed on a labeled set, needing no live traffic.
optionExplanations: 三者在漏斗上位置不同:点击→加购→购买,越往下越接近收入,不是同一件事。
对;这条漏斗把'看得爽'一路量化到'真花钱',购买提升是最终业务价值锚。
指标张冠李戴:CTR 不测收入、加购不测延迟;这项定义全错。
在线指标必须靠真实流量测(A/B),不是离线能算的。
optionExplanations_en: They sit at different funnel steps: click to add-to-cart to purchase, each closer to revenue — not the same thing.
Correct — this funnel quantifies from 'visually appealing' to 'actually spends', with purchase lift as the final value anchor.
Misattributed: CTR doesn't measure revenue and add-to-cart doesn't measure latency; the definitions are wrong.
Online metrics require real traffic (A/B), not offline computation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被点击的结果里被加入购物车的比例,反映购买意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Add-to-cart rate is the fraction of clicked results added to the cart, reflecting purchase intent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 视觉搜索相对基线(文本搜索/无搜索)带来的增量收入,是最终业务价值指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Purchase lift is the incremental revenue visual search brings over a baseline (text search / no search), the ultimate business-value metric.

scenario: 离线 Recall@50 提升了 8%,上线后 CTR 却掉了 3%;查结果发现返回了 10 条几乎一模一样的黑裙。
scenario_en: Offline Recall@50 rose 8%, but after shipping CTR fell 3%; inspection shows 10 near-identical black dresses returned.
q: 这个'多样性陷阱'的成因是什么?
q_en: What causes this 'diversity trap'?
why: embedding 聚得更紧→召回更多但高度雷同(10 条几乎相同的黑裙)。离线指标独立给每个结果打分,不管彼此像不像;用户却整屏一起看,一排雷同就没得挑→CTR 跌。这是视觉搜索最常见的翻车。
why_en: Tighter embeddings retrieve more but near-identical items (10 almost-same black dresses); offline metrics score each result independently regardless of similarity, but users judge the whole screen and a row of clones gives no choice, so CTR drops — visual search's most common failure.
options: 延迟变高导致用户没耐心离开,和结果内容本身无关
召回更多但结果高度雷同,用户整屏看到一排相似款就不点
召回率下降导致返回结果变少,用户根本没得可点
NSFW 过滤误删了太多商品,导致结果数量严重不足
options_en: Higher latency drives impatient users away, unrelated to result content itself.
It retrieves more but near-identical items, so users see a row of clones and don't click.
Recall dropped so fewer results came back and there was nothing to click.
NSFW filtering wrongly removed too many products, leaving far too few results.
optionExplanations: 问题不在延迟:recall 是涨的,结果也够多,坏在结果彼此太像。
对;根因是离线独立评分 vs 用户整屏判断的错配,一排雷同抹掉了可选性→CTR 跌。
recall 是涨了 8% 不是降,结果不缺;缺的是多样性。
这不是 NSFW 误删,而是召回项互相雷同缺乏多样性。
optionExplanations_en: It's not latency: recall rose and results are plentiful; the flaw is results being too alike.
Correct — the root is the mismatch between independent offline scoring and holistic user judgment; a row of clones removes choice, so CTR drops.
Recall rose 8% not fell, so results aren't scarce; diversity is what's missing.
This isn't NSFW over-removal but retrieved items being near-identical, lacking diversity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只优化相关召回导致返回一堆雷同结果,离线指标涨但用户体验(CTR)反跌。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The diversity trap: optimizing pure relevance recall yields near-identical results, so offline metrics rise but user CTR falls.

scenario: 想从原理上解释为什么 Precision/Recall 这类离线指标发现不了'一排雷同结果'的问题。
scenario_en: Explain in principle why offline metrics like Precision/Recall can't detect a 'row of near-identical results'.
q: 为什么离线相关性指标天生看不见多样性问题?
q_en: Why are offline relevance metrics inherently blind to diversity?
why: Precision/Recall/NDCG 对每个结果独立判'相关不相关',10 条都相关就都算命中、指标很高——它们不看结果之间像不像。而用户是把一屏结果当一个整体看,雷同就没得挑。独立评分 vs 整体感知的错配就是盲区根源。
why_en: Precision/Recall/NDCG judge each result's relevance independently, so 10 relevant clones all count as hits and score high — they never look at pairwise similarity, while users perceive the whole screen as a set, so clones offer no choice; the independent-vs-holistic mismatch is the blind spot.
options: 因为它们只看第一个相关结果,后面的雷同项看不到
因为它们对每个结果独立评分,不看结果之间的相似度
因为它们需要分级标签,而多样性这件事无法标注
因为它们都是在线指标,在离线评估集上跑不出来
options_en: Because they look only at the first relevant result and miss later clones.
Because they score each result independently and never compare results with each other.
Because they need graded labels, and diversity simply cannot be labeled.
Because they are online metrics that cannot run on an offline evaluation set.
optionExplanations: 只看第一个是 MRR 的特性,不是所有离线指标;整组打分的指标一样漏多样性。
对;根因是'逐个独立评分'——指标里没有任何一项衡量结果彼此的差异度。
多样性其实可量化(intra-list distance/coverage),不是'无法标注';盲区来自独立评分。
这三个指标本来就在离线标注集上算,和线上流量无关;这项事实错误。
optionExplanations_en: Looking only at the first hit is MRR-specific; metrics that score the whole set still miss diversity.
Correct — the root is per-result independent scoring; no term measures how different results are from each other.
Diversity is quantifiable (intra-list distance/coverage), not 'unlabelable'; the blind spot is independent scoring.
All three are computed on an offline labeled set with no live traffic involved; this option is factually wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户把一屏返回结果当作一个集合整体评价,而非逐个独立看。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Holistic judgment is users evaluating the returned results as a whole set, not one at a time.

scenario: 为了不再掉进多样性陷阱,要加一组守护指标(guardrail)去监控结果集是否过于雷同。
scenario_en: To avoid the diversity trap, add guardrail metrics to monitor whether the result set is too homogeneous.
q: 哪些指标可以作为多样性守护指标?(多选)
q_en: Which metrics work as diversity guardrails? (multiple)
why: 覆盖度=结果集覆盖了多少个目录品类,低了说明扎堆;组内距离=返回向量两两平均距离,小了说明彼此雷同。Precision@K 只测相关不测多样。
why_en: Coverage is how many catalog categories the result set spans (low means clumped) and intra-list distance is the average pairwise distance among returned vectors (small means clones) — both quantify how homogeneous a screen is, while Precision@K measures relevance not diversity.
options: 覆盖度(coverage)——结果集覆盖了多少个目录品类
组内距离(intra-list distance)——返回向量两两平均距离,小则雷同
Precision@K——top-K 里相关项的比例
p99 延迟——99% 请求的响应时间
options_en: Coverage — how many catalog categories the result set spans.
Intra-list distance — average pairwise distance among returned vectors; small means clones.
Precision@K — the fraction of the top-K that are relevant.
P99 latency — the response time for 99% of requests.
optionExplanations: 对;覆盖多个品类=结果不扎堆,coverage 低直接暴露同质化。
对;组内距离小=向量彼此太近=一排雷同,是多样性最直接的量化。
Precision 只测'相关不相关',10 条雷同也可以都相关、precision 很高,测不出多样性。
p99 是延迟守护指标,不衡量结果多样性,属于另一类 guardrail。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — spanning many categories means results aren't clumped; low coverage directly exposes homogeneity.
Correct — small intra-list distance means vectors are too close, a row of clones — the most direct diversity quantification.
Precision measures relevance only; 10 clones can all be relevant with high precision, so it can't detect diversity.
P99 is a latency guardrail, not a diversity measure — a different kind of guardrail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果集覆盖了目录中多少个品类的比例,低覆盖=结果扎堆同质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Coverage is the fraction of catalog categories represented in the result set; low coverage means clumped, homogeneous results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回结果向量之间的平均两两距离,越小说明结果彼此越雷同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Intra-list distance is the average pairwise distance among returned result vectors; smaller means more near-identical results.

scenario: 新版模型上线后 Recall@50 从 0.72 提升到 0.80,但 CTR 下降了 4%。
scenario_en: After a new model ships, Recall@50 rises from 0.72 to 0.80 but CTR drops 4%.
q: 这个'离线涨、线上跌'最可能的解释是什么?
q_en: What most likely explains this 'offline up, online down'?
why: 最可能是结果更相关但更不多样:embedding 聚更紧,召回涨(0.72→0.80),但返回一堆彼此雷同的项,用户没得挑→参与度/CTR 跌 4%。这是多样性陷阱的典型信号,应加 coverage/组内距离守护再排查。
why_en: Most likely more relevant but less diverse: tighter embeddings raise recall (0.72 to 0.80) but return near-identical items giving users no choice, so engagement/CTR falls 4% — the classic diversity-trap signal, addressed by adding coverage/intra-list-distance guardrails.
options: 线上流量太小,4% 只是噪声,不用管
结果更相关但更不多样,一排雷同让用户没得挑,参与度/CTR 下降
召回率下降导致结果变少(注意 recall 明明是涨的)
延迟超标触发了自动回滚,CTR 因此下降
options_en: Traffic is too small, 4% is just noise, ignore it.
More relevant but less diverse: a row of clones gives users no choice, dropping engagement/CTR.
Recall dropped so fewer results (note recall clearly rose).
Latency breached SLO and triggered auto-rollback, dropping CTR.
optionExplanations: recall 明确涨了 8 个点、CTR 明确跌了 4%,是系统性反向不是噪声。
对;相关↑但多样↓正是多样性陷阱,先量一屏结果彼此的向量距离就能确认。
recall 是 0.72→0.80 涨的,不是降;结果不缺,缺多样性。
题里没有延迟超标或回滚信号,把 CTR 跌归因于回滚是无据推断。
optionExplanations_en: Recall clearly rose 8 points and CTR clearly fell 4% — a systematic inverse, not noise.
Correct — relevance up but diversity down is the diversity trap; measuring pairwise vector distance within one screen confirms it.
Recall rose 0.72 to 0.80, not fell; results aren't scarce, diversity is.
There's no SLO breach or rollback signal here; blaming CTR on rollback is unfounded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户与结果的互动强度(点击/停留/加购),CTR 是其常用代理指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Engagement is how much users interact with results (clicks/dwell/carts), with CTR a common proxy.

scenario: 离线指标和线上指标都看了,还想确定'是这次模型改动导致了业务变化',而不是季节/流量波动。
scenario_en: You've seen offline and online metrics but want to confirm 'this model change caused the business shift', not seasonality/traffic noise.
q: A/B 测试在评估体系里独有的价值是什么?
q_en: What is A/B testing's unique value in the evaluation stack?
why: A/B 测试提供改动与业务结果之间的因果链:把用户随机分到对照(v1)和实验(v2)两臂,同时期同环境对比,排除季节/流量等混杂,才能说'是这次改动导致了指标变化'。离线/在线观察指标本身给不出因果。
why_en: A/B testing provides the causal link between a change and a business outcome: randomly split users into control (v1) and treatment (v2), compared in the same period and environment to rule out seasonality/traffic confounds, which observational offline/online metrics alone cannot establish.
options: 它能替代离线指标,有了 A/B 就不用离线评估了
它提供改动与业务结果的因果链,靠随机分臂排除季节/流量等混杂
它主要用来降低 serving 延迟
它只是把在线指标再算一遍,没有额外价值
options_en: It replaces offline metrics; with A/B you no longer need offline evaluation.
It provides the causal link between a change and business outcome, using randomized arms to rule out seasonality/traffic confounds.
It's mainly for reducing serving latency.
It just recomputes online metrics with no added value.
optionExplanations: A/B 不替代离线:离线是上线前快速筛,A/B 是上线后验因果,两者互补。
对;随机分臂+同期对比消混杂,这是唯一能下'因果'结论的手段。
A/B 测的是业务因果不是延迟;延迟是要盯的守护指标不是 A/B 的目的。
A/B 的价值恰在'随机对照'带来的因果性,不是重复计算在线指标。
optionExplanations_en: A/B doesn't replace offline: offline is the pre-ship fast filter, A/B is the post-ship causal test — complementary.
Correct — randomized arms plus same-period comparison remove confounds, the only way to conclude causation.
A/B tests business causation, not latency; latency is a guardrail to watch, not A/B's purpose.
A/B's value is the causality from randomized control, not recomputing online metrics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户随机分到对照组和实验组,同期对比业务指标,建立改动→结果的因果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A/B testing randomly splits users into control and treatment, comparing business metrics in the same period to establish a change-to-outcome causal link.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时影响改动和结果的第三因素(如季节、流量),随机分组用来抵消它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A confounder is a third factor (seasonality, traffic) affecting both change and outcome; randomization cancels it.

scenario: 视觉搜索的 A/B 要选随机化单元。一个用户一次会话里可能连传 3 张照片,你在 user 级和 query 级随机之间选。
scenario_en: Choosing the A/B randomization unit: a user may upload 3 photos in one session; pick between user-level and query-level randomization.
q: 视觉搜索 A/B 该按什么粒度随机分组?
q_en: At what granularity should visual-search A/B randomize?
why: 按用户(user-level)随机:同一用户一次会话里传多张图应看到同一个模型版本,否则 query 级随机会让他一会儿 v1 一会儿 v2、体验割裂,也污染购买等会话级指标。user-level 保证会话内一致,是首选。
why_en: Randomize at user level: a user uploading several photos in one session should see one model version, else query-level randomization flips them between v1 and v2 within a session, giving inconsistent experiences and polluting session-level metrics like purchase — so user-level is preferred.
tradeoff: user 级(会话内一致但样本单元少) vs query 级(样本多但会话内体验割裂)
options: 按 query 随机,样本量最大所以在任何场景下都最优
按用户(user-level)随机,同一会话内始终看到同一版本
按天随机,今天全流量走 v1、明天全流量走 v2
按索引分片随机,不同分片各自跑不同的模型版本
options_en: Randomize by query for the largest sample, which is optimal in every scenario.
Randomize by user so one session always sees the same version.
Randomize by day: all traffic on v1 today, all on v2 tomorrow.
Randomize by index shard, with each shard running a different model version.
whenOtherWins: 若每次查询相互独立、没有会话级体验或指标(纯一次性检索),query 级随机能用更小流量更快拿到显著性。
whenOtherWins_en: If queries are independent with no session-level experience or metrics (purely one-shot retrieval), query-level randomization reaches significance faster with less traffic.
optionExplanations: query 级样本虽多,但会话内切版本会割裂体验、污染购买等会话指标,不是无脑最优。
对;user-level 让同一用户会话内版本一致,既保体验又让会话级因果干净。
按天随机=前后时段对比,混入季节/流量差异,不是并行随机对照。
按分片随机把系统差异和实验混在一起,无法归因到模型版本,是错误设计。
optionExplanations_en: Query-level has more samples but flipping versions within a session breaks experience and pollutes session metrics like purchase — not blindly optimal.
Correct — user-level keeps one user's version consistent within a session, preserving experience and clean session-level causation.
Day-level randomization compares time periods, mixing in seasonality/traffic — not parallel randomized control.
Shard-level randomization confounds system differences with the experiment, so you can't attribute to model version — a flawed design.

termDefinitions.meaning: A/B 里被随机分到各实验臂的实体(用户/会话/查询),决定指标口径和一致性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The randomization unit is the entity assigned to A/B arms (user/session/query), setting metric scope and consistency.

scenario: 视觉搜索是相对低流量的入口,A/B 的主指标是购买提升(方差大、转化稀疏)。
scenario_en: Visual search is a relatively low-traffic entry, and the A/B primary metric is purchase lift (high variance, sparse conversion).
q: 为什么这个 A/B 通常要跑 2-4 周,而不是几天?
q_en: Why does this A/B typically run 2-4 weeks rather than a few days?
why: 流量低+购买稀疏=每天累积的有效样本少,要跑 2-4 周才能攒够样本让购买提升达到统计显著。急着几天就结论,样本不足会把噪声当信号→假阳/假阴决策。2-4 周是给定经验窗口不是公式推导。
why_en: Low traffic plus sparse purchases means few effective samples per day, so 2-4 weeks are needed to accumulate enough for purchase lift to reach statistical significance; rushing in days risks mistaking noise for signal — 2-4 weeks is an empirical window, not a formula.
options: 跑久是为了让线上模型有时间继续训练变得更好
低流量+购买稀疏,样本累积慢,2-4 周才够统计显著
跑 2-4 周纯粹是公司发布流程规定,和统计功效无关
跑 2-4 周是为了等 embedding 索引重建完成
options_en: Run it long so the live model has time to keep training and improve.
Low traffic plus sparse purchases accumulate samples slowly, so 2-4 weeks are needed for significance.
The 2-4 weeks is purely a company release-process rule, unrelated to statistical power.
The 2-4 weeks waits for the embedding index rebuild to finish.
optionExplanations: A/B 期间模型是固定的两臂对比,不在训练;跑久是为攒样本不是练模型。
对;显著性取决于样本量,低流量场景就得靠时间累积,这是给定经验窗口。
不是走流程:统计显著需要足够样本,低流量下就得用时间换样本量。
索引重建是部署侧的事,和 A/B 需要多久达到显著无关。
optionExplanations_en: During A/B the two arms are fixed comparisons, not training; running long accumulates samples, not model skill.
Correct — significance depends on sample size, and low traffic needs time to accumulate it, an empirical window.
Not process for its own sake: statistical significance needs enough samples, and low traffic buys them with time.
Index rebuild is a deployment concern, unrelated to how long A/B needs to reach significance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 观测到的指标差异不太可能只是随机波动,需要足够样本量才能确立。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Statistical significance means an observed metric difference is unlikely to be random noise, requiring enough samples.

scenario: 设计视觉搜索 A/B:v2 模型+v2 索引 vs v1 对照。要定主指标和次指标。
scenario_en: Design a visual-search A/B: v2 model + v2 index vs v1 control; set primary and secondary metrics.
q: 主指标和次指标各该选什么,为什么这样分层?
q_en: What should the primary and secondary metrics be, and why this layering?
why: 主指标选购买提升(最贴业务价值、直接对齐收入);次指标选 CTR、加购率、会话时长(帮助解释主指标为何变、更灵敏能早看到方向)。主指标定成败,次指标帮归因,分层避免拿灵敏但离钱远的指标当最终裁判。
why_en: Primary is purchase lift (closest to business value, aligned with revenue); secondaries are CTR, add-to-cart, session duration (explain why the primary moved and are more sensitive early). The primary decides success, secondaries aid attribution, avoiding letting a sensitive-but-distant metric be the final judge.
tradeoff: 主指标=购买提升(贴业务但迟钝) + 次指标=CTR/加购(灵敏但离钱远)
options: 主指标 p99 延迟,次指标购买提升与 CTR
主指标购买提升,次指标 CTR/加购率/会话时长帮归因
主指标 CTR,次指标一律不设,越简单越好
主指标离线 Recall@50,次指标离线 Precision@10
options_en: Primary p99 latency, secondaries purchase lift and CTR.
Primary purchase lift, secondaries CTR/add-to-cart/session duration for attribution.
Primary CTR with no secondaries at all, since simpler is better.
Primary offline Recall@50, secondary offline Precision@10.
whenOtherWins: 若本次实验目标就是纯排序/相关性改进而非直接收入(如内部检索质量迭代),可把 CTR/NDCG 当主指标、购买提升作参考。
whenOtherWins_en: If the experiment targets pure ranking/relevance rather than direct revenue (internal retrieval-quality iteration), CTR/NDCG can be primary with purchase lift as reference.
optionExplanations: 延迟是守护指标不是主指标;主指标应是业务价值(购买提升),延迟只需不回退。
对;购买提升定成败、CTR/加购/时长帮解释,分层兼顾业务对齐与可归因。
不设次指标就没法解释主指标为何变;次指标对归因和早期方向判断很有用。
A/B 是在线因果实验,主指标该是线上业务指标;离线指标是上线前的筛,不作 A/B 主裁判。
optionExplanations_en: Latency is a guardrail not a primary; the primary should be business value (purchase lift), with latency only required not to regress.
Correct — purchase lift decides success while CTR/cart/duration explain it, layering business alignment with attribution.
No secondaries means you can't explain why the primary moved; secondaries help attribution and early direction.
A/B is an online causal experiment, so the primary should be an online business metric; offline metrics are the pre-ship filter, not the A/B judge.

termDefinitions.term: 主指标/次指标 / primary & secondary metric
termDefinitions.meaning: 主指标定实验成败(贴业务),次指标帮助解释主指标为何变化并更早显灵敏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The primary metric decides success (business-aligned) while secondary metrics explain why it moved and show sensitivity earlier.

scenario: A/B 里除了看主指标涨不涨,还要设一组'绝不能回退'的守护指标,任一恶化就叫停/回滚。
scenario_en: Beyond the primary metric, set guardrail metrics that must not regress; any degradation triggers halt/rollback.
q: 视觉搜索 A/B 的守护指标(guardrail)应包含哪些?(多选)
q_en: Which guardrail metrics should a visual-search A/B include? (multiple)
why: 守护指标是'即使主指标涨也不许恶化'的底线:p99 延迟不得破 200ms SLO(体验)、NSFW 事故率不得高于基线(安全)、多样性(coverage/组内距离)不得下降(防多样性陷阱)。任一回退就该叫停,哪怕购买提升在涨。
why_en: Guardrails are the floor even if the primary rises: p99 latency must not break the 200ms SLO (experience), NSFW incident rate must not exceed baseline (safety), and diversity (coverage/intra-list distance) must not drop (anti-diversity-trap); any regression halts the test even with rising purchase lift.
options: p99 延迟不得突破 200ms SLO
NSFW 事故率不得高于基线
多样性(coverage、组内距离)不得下降
训练用的 GPU 数量必须减少
options_en: P99 latency must not exceed the 200ms SLO.
NSFW incident rate must not exceed baseline.
Diversity (coverage, intra-list distance) must not drop.
The number of training GPUs must decrease.
optionExplanations: 对;延迟破 SLO 直接伤体验和转化,即便主指标涨也要拦。
对;NSFW 事故是安全红线,升高必须叫停,不能用业务收益抵。
对;多样性下降正是多样性陷阱的前兆,设成守护能在 CTR 塌之前拦住。
GPU 数量是训练成本,不是这个在线 A/B 的用户侧守护指标,和实验成败无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — breaking the latency SLO hurts experience and conversion, blocked even if the primary rises.
Correct — NSFW incidents are a safety red line; any rise halts the test and can't be offset by business gains.
Correct — falling diversity is the precursor to the diversity trap, so guarding it catches the issue before CTR collapses.
GPU count is a training cost, not a user-side guardrail for this online A/B, and unrelated to the experiment's success.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实验中不允许恶化的底线指标(延迟/安全/多样性),任一回退就叫停或回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail metric is a floor that must not regress (latency/safety/diversity); any breach halts or rolls back the experiment.

scenario: 上一课的蓝绿重建产出了 v2 索引;现在要把它接进 A/B 实验框架里。
scenario_en: The prior lesson's blue-green rebuild produced a v2 index; now wire it into the A/B experiment framework.
q: 蓝绿部署和 A/B 实验是怎么衔接的?
q_en: How do blue-green deployment and A/B testing connect?
why: 蓝绿重建出的 v2 索引直接充当实验臂:路由层按用户分桶把一部分流量导到 v2(实验),其余留在 v1(对照)。指标回退时自动回滚=把路由切回 v1。部署基建和实验框架共用同一个路由层,形成'实验→监控→自动回滚'闭环。
why_en: The blue-green v2 index serves as the treatment arm: the routing layer splits traffic by user bucket to v2 (treatment) with the rest on v1 (control), and automated rollback on metric regression just flips routing back to v1 — deployment and experiment share the same routing layer, forming an experiment-monitor-rollback loop.
options: 两者互不相关,A/B 要另外单独再搭一套 v2 索引
蓝绿的 v2 索引直接当实验臂,路由层按用户分桶分流
A/B 只能在离线评估集上跑,和线上蓝绿部署无关
蓝绿部署会自动跳过 A/B,验证通过就直接全量上线
options_en: They are unrelated; A/B requires building a separate v2 index of its own.
The blue-green v2 index doubles as the treatment arm, with the router splitting by user bucket.
A/B can only run on an offline evaluation set, unrelated to blue-green deployment.
Blue-green skips A/B automatically: once validated it goes fully live.
optionExplanations: 不用另搭:蓝绿本就并行跑着 v1/v2,复用 v2 当实验臂最省事。
对;共用路由层让分流和回滚都变成'切路由',部署与实验天然一体。
A/B 是在线实验,必须用线上流量;说它只能离线是错的。
蓝绿验证只保证质量达标,是否全量上仍应由 A/B 的业务因果决定,不能自动跳过。
optionExplanations_en: No separate build needed: blue-green already runs v1/v2 in parallel, so reusing v2 as the treatment arm is simplest.
Correct — a shared routing layer makes both splitting and rollback a routing flip, unifying deployment and experiment.
A/B is an online experiment requiring live traffic; saying it's offline-only is wrong.
Blue-green validation only ensures quality; whether to go fully live should still be decided by A/B's business causation, not auto-skipped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按用户 ID 哈希把用户稳定分到实验/对照桶,同一用户始终落同一臂。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User bucketing hashes user IDs to stably assign each user to a treatment/control bucket, keeping them in one arm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 监控到守护指标回退时自动把路由切回旧版本,无需人工介入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Automated rollback flips routing back to the old version when a guardrail regresses, without manual intervention.

scenario: 想用更小流量更快地比较两个排序版本;听说交错实验(interleaving)统计功效更高。
scenario_en: You want to compare two ranking versions faster with less traffic; interleaving experiments reportedly have higher statistical power.
q: 交错实验(interleaving)相比经典 A/B 的优势和局限是什么?
q_en: What are interleaving's advantages and limits versus classic A/B?
why: 交错实验把对照和实验的结果混在同一屏里给同一个用户,同人同屏对比→消掉用户间差异→对排序改动统计功效更高、更省流量。局限:当整组结果都变(不只是重排,而是换了检索模型)时很难交错,这时还得回经典 A/B。
why_en: Interleaving mixes control and treatment results in one page for the same user, so within-user comparison removes between-user variance, giving higher statistical power for ranking changes with less traffic; its limit is that when the whole result set changes (not just reordering) it's hard to interleave, so you fall back to classic A/B.
tradeoff: interleaving(排序改动功效高、省流量) vs 经典 A/B(整组换模型时才适用)
options: 交错实验永远优于经典 A/B,任何改动都该优先用它
同屏混合两版、同人对比功效更高;整组结果都变时难交错
交错实验只是经典 A/B 的另一个别名,两者没有区别
交错实验只能测延迟等系统指标,不能测排序质量
options_en: Interleaving always beats classic A/B and should be the first choice for any change.
Mixing both versions in one page gives within-user comparison and higher power, but is hard when the whole set changes.
Interleaving is just another name for classic A/B, with no real difference.
Interleaving can only measure system metrics like latency, not ranking quality.
optionExplanations: 不是永远更优:整组结果被换掉(换检索模型)时无法把两版干净交错,这正是它的边界。
对;同人同屏消用户间方差=更高功效,但只适合'重排类'改动;整组变就得经典 A/B。
交错和 A/B 机制不同:一个同屏混排、一个分臂对比,不是别名。
交错正是为比较排序质量设计的,不是测延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Not always better: when the whole set is swapped (new retrieval model) you can't cleanly interleave two versions — its boundary.
Correct — same-user same-page removes between-user variance for higher power, but suits reordering changes; whole-set changes need classic A/B.
Interleaving and A/B differ mechanically: one mixes in one page, the other splits into arms — not aliases.
Interleaving is designed to compare ranking quality, not to test latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把两个版本的结果混排在同一个结果页给同一用户,靠同人对比提高排序比较的统计功效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interleaving mixes two versions' results in one page for the same user, using within-user comparison to boost statistical power for ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真有差异时能检测出它的概率,功效高意味着用更少样本就能得出可信结论。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Statistical power is the probability of detecting a real difference; higher power means reliable conclusions from fewer samples.

scenario: A/B 里实验臂用 v2 模型+v2 索引;若查询用 v2 编码却打到 v1 embedding(版本没对齐),会怎样。
scenario_en: In the A/B, the treatment arm uses v2 model + v2 index; if a v2-encoded query hits v1 embeddings (versions unaligned), what happens?
q: 为什么 embedding 版本一致性是 A/B 比较有效的前提?
q_en: Why is embedding version consistency a prerequisite for a valid A/B?
why: 若实验臂的 query 编码和索引 embedding 版本不一致,会触发空间错配、召回崩坏,你测到的'v2 更差'其实是版本 bug 不是模型本身。必须保证每个臂内 query 与索引同版本,A/B 的因果结论才成立。
why_en: If the treatment arm's query encoding and index embeddings are version-mismatched, space misalignment collapses recall, so the 'v2 is worse' you measure is a version bug not the model, and only same-version query-index within each arm makes the A/B's causal conclusion valid.
options: 版本不一致没关系,A/B 的随机分组会自动抵消掉
版本错配会崩坏 v2 臂的召回,测到的'变差'其实是 bug
版本一致只影响查询延迟,不影响 A/B 的结论
只要对照臂版本对就行,实验臂版本乱一点也无所谓
options_en: Mismatched versions are fine; A/B randomization cancels the effect automatically.
A mismatch collapses recall in the v2 arm, so the 'worse' you measure is a bug.
Version consistency only affects query latency, not the A/B conclusion.
As long as the control arm is right, messy versions in the treatment arm are fine.
optionExplanations: 随机分组抵消的是用户间差异,抵消不了实验臂内部的版本 bug——那是系统性错误。
对;版本错配是实验臂里的系统性缺陷,会把 bug 冤枉成模型效果,因果结论就废了。
版本错配伤的是召回质量(空间错配),不只是延迟;它直接污染业务指标。
实验臂版本乱=你在拿一个坏掉的 v2 和 v1 比,得出的差异毫无意义。
optionExplanations_en: Randomization cancels between-user variance, not a within-arm version bug, which is a systematic error.
Correct — mismatch is a systematic defect in the treatment arm that blames a bug on the model, voiding the causal conclusion.
Mismatch harms recall quality (space misalignment), not just latency, and directly pollutes business metrics.
A messy-version treatment arm means comparing a broken v2 to v1, so any measured difference is meaningless.

termDefinitions.meaning: 查询编码器与索引 embedding 用同一版本,避免空间错配,是 A/B 结论可信的前提。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Version consistency means the query encoder and index embeddings share one version, avoiding space misalignment — a prerequisite for a trustworthy A/B.

q: 把'评估→部署→业务→反馈'的闭环按运转顺序排好:
q_en: Order the evaluation-deployment-business-feedback closed loop:
steps: 守护指标回退触发自动回滚,把路由切回上一版
离线用黄金集算 Precision/Recall/NDCG,筛出候选新模型
监控主指标(购买提升)和守护指标(延迟/NSFW/多样性)
蓝绿把候选 v2 当实验臂,路由按用户分桶做 A/B
why: 闭环:离线筛出候选→蓝绿把 v2 当实验臂做 A/B→线上监控主指标与守护指标→守护回退就自动回滚(否则放量)。Staff+ 的加分点正是把评估、部署、业务影响串成一个自我纠错的反馈回路。
why_en: The loop: offline filters candidates, blue-green runs v2 as the treatment arm in A/B, production monitors primary and guardrail metrics, and a guardrail regression triggers automated rollback (else ramp up) — the Staff+ differentiator is closing evaluation, deployment, and business impact into a self-correcting loop.
diagram:
flowchart LR O["离线筛候选
Precision/Recall/NDCG"] --> A["蓝绿 A-B
v2 当实验臂"] A --> M["监控主指标+守护指标"] M -->|守护回退| R["自动回滚"] M -->|全绿| O

termDefinitions.term: 闭环反馈 / closed feedback loop
termDefinitions.meaning: 评估、部署、业务监控、自动回滚串成自我纠错回路,持续把系统往更好推。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A closed feedback loop chains evaluation, deployment, business monitoring, and automated rollback into a self-correcting cycle that keeps improving the system.

scenario: 面试评级:同一道视觉搜索评估题,L4/L5/Staff+ 的回答深度不同,面试官据此定级。
scenario_en: Interview leveling: on the same visual-search evaluation question, L4/L5/Staff+ answers differ in depth, and the interviewer levels accordingly.
q: 什么样的评估回答能体现 Staff+ 而非 L5?
q_en: What kind of evaluation answer signals Staff+ rather than L5?
why: L5 能设 A/B(随机单元、主/次指标+守护)并点出离线-在线差距。Staff+ 再进一步:不用提示就抛多样性-相关性取舍、加 coverage 守护、把指标回退接到自动回滚。
why_en: L5 designs the A/B (randomization unit, primary/secondary plus guardrails) and names the offline-online gap and diversity; Staff+ goes further — raising the diversity-relevance tradeoff unprompted, proposing coverage/intra-list guardrails, discussing interleaving, connecting purchase lift to revenue and regressions to automated rollback, and stressing version consistency, i.e. evaluation+deployment+business as one closed loop.
tradeoff: L5(会设 A/B+识别差距) vs Staff+(主动抛多样性取舍+闭环+自动回滚)
options: 只报出 Precision@K、Recall@K 两个离线指标的名字
会设计 A/B 并识别离线-在线差距,但需被追问才想到多样性
不用提示就抛多样性-相关性取舍、加 coverage 守护、回退接自动回滚
把所有离线指标的公式背诵一遍,完全不谈部署与业务闭环
options_en: Just names two offline metrics by name, Precision@K and Recall@K.
Designs an A/B and spots the offline-online gap, but needs prompting to reach diversity.
Unprompted raises the diversity-relevance tradeoff, adds coverage guardrails, wires regressions to automated rollback.
Recites every offline metric formula and never touches deployment or the business loop.
whenOtherWins: 如果岗位就是 L4/L5,能命名指标、讲清 precision-recall 取舍并设计基本 A/B 已达标,不必强求 Staff+ 的闭环深度。
whenOtherWins_en: For an L4/L5 role, naming metrics, explaining the precision-recall tradeoff, and designing a basic A/B already meets the bar, without requiring Staff+ closed-loop depth.
optionExplanations: 只报指标名是 L4 水平,没有取舍和系统视角,离 Staff+ 很远。
会设 A/B、识别差距是 L5;差在'需追问才想到多样性',主动性不足。
对;主动抛取舍+闭环+自动回滚+版本一致,展示的是系统级因果闭环思维,这是 Staff+ 分水岭。
背公式不谈部署/业务,恰恰缺了 Staff+ 最看重的系统与业务闭环,反而更像初级。
optionExplanations_en: Just naming metrics is L4 level, lacking tradeoffs and a systems view, far from Staff+.
Designing an A/B and spotting the gap is L5; the gap is needing a prompt to reach diversity — insufficient initiative.
Correct — unprompted tradeoff plus closed loop plus automated rollback plus version consistency shows systems-level causal-loop thinking, the Staff+ divide.
Reciting formulas without deployment/business misses exactly the systems-and-business loop Staff+ values, reading as more junior.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把评估、部署、业务影响串成自我纠错闭环并主动抛出多样性取舍的系统级思维。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Staff+ differentiator is systems-level thinking that closes evaluation, deployment, and business impact into a self-correcting loop and raises the diversity tradeoff unprompted.
